findings.title: Public function renamed/relocated without visible update of call sites or tests
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold` (previously defined in `sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py`) has been renamed to `try_incident_threshold` and moved into a new module `sentry/monitors/logic/incidents.py`. The PR only touches 4 files, with no accompanying changes to any test files. Sentry's existing unit tests for monitor failure handling commonly import and/or `mock.patch` these internal functions directly (e.g. `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.mark_failed_threshold`). Since the symbol no longer exists under the old module path/name, any such import or patch target will now raise `ImportError`/`AttributeError`, breaking the test suite. If no test updates exist elsewhere in this change set, CI will fail.

findings.title: create_issue_platform_occurrence renamed to create_incident_occurrence and moved, along with helper symbols, without compatibility shim
findings.body: `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP`, `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP`, and `get_monitor_environment_context` were all removed from `sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py` and relocated/renamed in the new `incident_occurrence.py` module. These were previously public (non-underscore-prefixed) names in `mark_failed.py` and are the kind of symbols that get imported directly or mocked in tests (e.g. `mock.patch('sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence')`). No test files are included in this change, so any existing references to the old module path/names will fail at import/patch time, constituting an unannounced API break for internal consumers and tests.

findings.title: SimpleCheckIn moved to types.py without checking for other importers
findings.body: `SimpleCheckIn` was previously defined in `sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py` and is now defined in `sentry/monitors/types.py`, with `mark_failed.py` no longer exposing it. Any other module or test that imported `SimpleCheckIn` from its old location (`sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`) will break with an `ImportError` since it is not re-exported from the old path for backward compatibility.
